Company Formation

In most business activities, yes. Ownership rules depend on your activity and jurisdiction (mainland or free zone). We confirm eligibility for your specific activity before you commit.

A mainland licence lets you trade across the UAE and with government entities, while a free zone licence offers a simpler setup and is usually limited to trading within the zone or internationally. We compare both against your business plan.

Timelines depend on the jurisdiction, the activity and how quickly documents are provided. After reviewing your file we give you a realistic timeline.

Most licences require registered office space, but the type (flexi-desk, shared or dedicated) depends on the jurisdiction and activity. We advise on the lowest-cost compliant option.

PRO Services

A PRO (Public Relations Officer) handles government paperwork on your behalf: visas, labour cards, licence renewals, approvals and attestations, so you do not have to queue at government offices.

We handle transactions with immigration, labour, free zone authorities, municipalities, chambers of commerce and other UAE entities.

Yes. We track expiry dates for licences, visas and cards and renew them ahead of time to avoid fines.

Visa Processing

Employment, investor, family sponsorship, tourist and golden visa applications, as well as renewals and cancellations.

No. Decisions are made by the authorities. What we do is prepare a complete, correct application, which reduces delays and avoidable rejections.

Processing time depends on the visa type and the authority. We give you an estimate after reviewing your documents and keep you updated until a decision.

A valid passport, photo and supporting documents that vary by visa type, such as a sponsor or company file and a medical fitness result. We send you a checklist for your case.

Document Clearing

Attestation is the official verification of a document by the relevant authorities so it is accepted in another country, for example certificates, contracts or powers of attorney for use in the UAE.

Educational, personal (marriage, birth) and commercial documents, powers of attorney and agreements. Contact us with your document and destination and we will confirm the steps.

Express options are available for many document types. Availability and timing depend on the authority involved.

Bank Account Opening

No. Banks make their own compliance decisions. We prepare a complete application and introduce you to banks that fit your profile to improve your chances.

Typically the trade licence, memorandum of association, shareholder and manager IDs, proof of address and a business profile. Requirements vary by bank.

Some banks require an in-person visit and others support remote steps. We confirm the process for your chosen bank.

Business Immigration

A long-term residence visa for eligible investors, entrepreneurs and skilled professionals. Eligibility depends on the category and current rules.

Yes, owners and partners of a UAE company can usually apply for residence linked to the company. Requirements depend on the licence type.

Eligible residents can generally sponsor family members. We prepare the documentation for each sponsored person.
